title: Space Chatter - Volume Settings (requires Cloud voice provider(s))
Space Chatter volume
desc: The master volume for all Space Chatter voices (0-100) - other Space Chatter volume settings will be a percentage of this value.

title: NPC message volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages received from NPCs in game (eg. pirates, cruise ships etc) (0-100)

title: Local message volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages received on the Local channel (eg. player messages) (0-100)

title: StarSystem message volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages received from within system (eg. Commander messages) (0-100)

title: Direct message volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages received directly from Commanders to you (0-100)

title: Station chatter volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages generated when around a station (docking, undocking, galnet discussions etc)  (0-100)

title: Social Space chatter volume
desc: Set the volume of the messages heard when in a station concourse or bar (NPCs and tannoy broadcasts)  (0-100)

title: Fleet Carrier / station greetings volume
desc: Set the volume of the greetings received from a Fleet Carrier or Station (0-100)
